AddGroupMember.description_en: Adds a member to a group

AddStoryFiles.description_en: Adds files to a specified story

ArchiveFiles.description_en: Archives files and folders into a package for download

AssignRole.description_en: This operation assigns the team administrator role to a user
AssignRole.description_zh: 当前支持将用户设置为团队管理员角色

Batch.description_en: Combine multiple API calls into a single request to improve efficiency
Batch.description_zh: 支持批量调用部分API，提升调用效率

CancelAssignRole.description_en: Currently, this operation only revokes the team administrator role
CancelAssignRole.description_zh: 当前仅支持取消团队管理员角色

ClearRecyclebin.description_en: Permanently deletes all files and folders in the recycle bin
ClearRecyclebin.description_zh: 清空回收站中所有文件和文件夹

CreateCustomizedStory.description_en: Creates a customized story. Unlike a recommended story, you specify the files in a customized story
CreateCustomizedStory.description_zh:
创建自定义故事。
区别于推荐故事，自定义故事下面的文件列表由用户指定

CreateIdentityToBenefitPkgMapping.description_en: Creates a mapping between an entity and a benefit package. This operation lets you assign a benefit package to a user
CreateIdentityToBenefitPkgMapping.description_zh: 创建实体和权益包关联，可用于给用户绑定权益包

CreateSimilarImageClusterTask.description_en: Creates a task that clusters similar images in a specified drive
CreateSimilarImageClusterTask.description_zh: 用户可以发起创建相似图片聚类任务，该任务会将指定 drive 空间下相似的图片聚类在一起

CreateStory.description_en: Creates a suggested story. PDS filters images and videos in a drive based on the story type and time range in the request. PDS then adds the matching files to the story. If no images or videos match the criteria, an empty story is created
CreateStory.description_zh:
创建推荐故事。
PDS 会根据请求参数中的故事类型和时间范围筛选 drive 空间下的图片和视频，将符合条件的图片、视频加入该故事的文件列表。
若没有符合条件的图片、视频，则会创建空故事

CsiGetFileInfo.description_en: Retrieves the content security details of a file
CsiGetFileInfo.description_zh: 获取文件的内容安全详情

DeleteGroup.description_en: Deletes a group. Before deleting a group, ensure it contains no other groups or users. Otherwise, the deletion fails
DeleteGroup.description_zh: 删除群组接口， 在删除群组前，需保证群组下没有其他群组或用户，否则会导致删除失败

DeleteRevision.description_en: Deletes a historical revision. You cannot delete the latest revision
DeleteRevision.description_zh: 删除历史版本，不支持删除最新版本

DeltaGetLastCursor.description_en: Retrieves the latest cursor for delta operations

FileAddPermission.description_en: Grants folder-level authorization. Each drive supports a maximum of 1000 authorization records. Authorization records that exceed this limit do not take effect
FileAddPermission.description_zh: 文件夹授权。单Drive下最多可支持1000条授权记录，超出后授权不生效

FileDeleteUserTags.description_en: Deletes custom tags from a file

FileListPermission.description_en: Lists the permission records for a file
FileListPermission.description_zh: 列举文件的共享或授权记录

FilePutUserTags.description_en: Adds custom tags to a file
FilePutUserTags.description_zh: 对文件添加自定义标签

GetAsyncTask.description_en: Retrieves information about an asynchronous task

GetDefaultDrive.description_en: Retrieves the default drive for a specified user
GetDefaultDrive.description_zh: 获取指定用户的缺省空间

GetDownloadUrl.description_en: Retrieves the download URL for a file

GetFile.description_en: Gets the details of a file

GetIdentityToBenefitPkgMapping.description_en: Retrieves the mapping between an identity and a benefit package. Use this operation to query the benefit packages that are bound to a user
GetIdentityToBenefitPkgMapping.description_zh: 获取实体和权益包关联，可用于获取用户绑定的权益包

GetLinkInfoByUserId.description_en: Obtain account information by user ID
GetLinkInfoByUserId.description_zh: 根据用户ID获取账号信息

GetRevision.description_en: Retrieves the details of a file revision

GetShareLink.description_en: Retrieves information about a share link

GetShareLinkByAnonymous.description_en: Retrieves the metadata of a share link without authentication

GetStory.description_en: Retrieves the details of a story, including its cover and file list
GetStory.description_zh: 获取指定故事详情，包含封面、文件列表等

GetTaskStatus.description_en:
Gets the status of an asynchronous task for a value-added service.
This API currently supports tasks created by operations such as `CreateSimilarImageClusterTask`
GetTaskStatus.description_zh:
查询增值服务异步任务执行状态。
目前支持的接口有：CreateSimilarImageClusterTask

InvestigateFile.description_zh: 将未经审核的文件送审

ListAssignment.description_zh: 列举已分配的角色列表

ListFile.description_en: Lists the files and folders that are immediate children of a specified folder
ListFile.description_zh: 直接文件夹下列举文件和文件夹

ListIdentityToBenefitPkgMapping.description_en: Lists the mappings between identities and benefit packages. Use this API to retrieve the benefit packages bound to a user
ListIdentityToBenefitPkgMapping.description_zh: 列举实体和权益包关联，可用于获取用户绑定的权益包列表

ListMyDrives.description_en: Retrieves a list of Drives for the logged-in user
ListMyDrives.description_zh: 列举登录用户自己的空间列表

ListMyGroupDrive.description_zh: 列举被授权的团队空间列表

ListReceivedFile.description_en: Lists files shared with the current user from a personal space
ListReceivedFile.description_zh: 收到的共享， 可通过此接口获取到从个人空间授权给此用户的文件列表

ListRecyclebin.description_en: Lists the files and folders in the recycle bin

ListRevision.description_en: Lists the revisions of a file

ListUploadedParts.description_en: Lists the parts that have been successfully uploaded for a specific multipart upload
ListUploadedParts.description_zh: 列举已上传成功的多段

RemoveFaceGroupFile.description_en: Removes a file from a face group
RemoveFaceGroupFile.description_zh: 删除人脸分组中的文件

RemoveGroupMember.description_en: Removes a member from a group

RemoveStoryFiles.description_en: Removes one or more files from a specified story
RemoveStoryFiles.description_zh: 移除指定故事中的文件

RestoreFile.description_en: Restores a file or folder from the recycle bin
RestoreFile.description_zh: 从回收站恢复文件或文件夹

RestoreRevision.description_en: Restores a historical revision of a file, making it the latest revision. This action creates a new revision, and the original historical revision remains unchanged. You cannot restore the latest revision
RestoreRevision.description_zh: 将文件的某个历史版本，还原为文件的最新版本，还原时生成一个新版本，被还原的版本不变。不支持还原最新版本

SearchAddressGroups.description_en: Searches for address groups based on a list of locations or a geographic area
SearchAddressGroups.description_zh: 根据地点列表查询地点聚类

SearchSimilarImageClusters.description_en: Retrieves similar image clusters in a specified drive
SearchSimilarImageClusters.description_zh: 获取指定 drive 空间下的相似图片

SearchStories.description_en: Retrieves stories from a specified drive that match the specified conditions
SearchStories.description_zh: 根据用户指定的条件，查询指定 drive 空间下的故事列表

Token.description_en: Obtains an access token as part of the OAuth 2.0 authorization flow
Token.description_zh: OAuth2.0授权流程的获取访问令牌

TrashFile.description_en: Moves a file or folder to the trash
TrashFile.description_zh: 文件或文件夹放入回收站

UnLinkAccount.description_en: Unlinks a specified identity from a user account

UpdateFacegroup.description_en: Updates the information for a specified face group

UpdateFile.description_en: Updates the metadata of a file without modifying its content

UpdateGroup.description_zh: 根据群组ID定位到指定的群组，并修改群组信息

UpdateIdentityToBenefitPkgMapping.description_en: Updates the association between an identity and a benefit package. Use this operation to assign a benefit package to a user
UpdateIdentityToBenefitPkgMapping.description_zh: 更新实体和权益包关联，可用于给用户绑定权益包

UpdateRevision.description_en: Updates information for a revision. You can set a revision to be kept forever or add a description. A maximum of 50 revisions per file can be kept forever
UpdateRevision.description_zh: 更新版本信息，设置版本为永久保留，或者添加版本描述信息。支持将一个文件的最多50个版本设置为永久保留

UpdateStory.description_en: Updates a specified story, including its name, tags, and cover
UpdateStory.description_zh: 更新指定故事的信息，包含名称、标签、自定义 id、封面等

VideoDRMLicense.description_en: Acquires a DRM license for a video
